Name: Weapons
Description:
Includes all standard weapons.
Bows can only be made using Carving.
Base Materials: Wood or Bone (if Carving), Metal (if Smithing)

Name: Armor (Light)
Base Materials: Cloth or Leather (if Tailoring), Wood or Bone (if Carving), Metal (if Smithing)

Name: Armor (Heavy)
Description: Includes all standard heavy armor. Can only be made using Smithing.

Name: Unarmed Enhancers
Description: Generally base item for Masterwork items, for unarmed attacks.
Base Materials: Cloth or Leather (if Tailoring), Metal (if Smithing)

Name: Medicinal Supply
Description: Used in place of cards for certain Medicine-related Techniques and similar uses.

Name: Other Items
Description: For various skill kits, adventuring goods, and other items that a character might want to create. Use whichever School/Skill Total fits the specific item — too variable to auto-match against a character's build, so this one's for reference only.
